adapter_evidence.product_pages: https://www.micron.com/products/<family path>/part-catalog/part-detail/<part number> is the per-part page. Its specifications render by script from the JSON endpoint the page itself names in data-apiresource (/content/micron/us/en/products/…/_jcr_content.products.json/getproductinfo/-/-/-/en_US/-/<part>), which returns name/value rows (density, speed, MT/s, voltage, temperature, interface, form factor, status).
adapter_evidence.family_pages: Family pages (e.g. /products/memory/hbm/hbm3e) carry marketing text only, no specification table.
adapter_evidence.robots: robots.txt allows /products/ and /content/micron/; it declares https://www.micron.com/sitemap.xml (part-detail URLs are listed there).

known_gaps: Specifications come from the official JSON component behind each part page; family pages have no specification table.
Power figures are not in the part JSON, so operation rows (HBM power) stay open until datasheets are reviewed.
CZ120 CXL memory has no part-detail page in the sitemap (2026-10-01).
map-sync is not enabled: the sitemap is one 6,000-URL file mixing obsolete and SPD pages; seeds name part pages explicitly.
